title: 1BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Rental with Pool Access
meta_description: Relax at Kidd Carriage House, a 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach vacation rental steps from the Cabana pool and beach, with a full kitchen. Sleeps 4.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Kidd Carriage House
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionPerfect for couples or small groups, Kidd Carriage House is a flawless flat with a luxurious, beachy flair. Located behind Kidd Cottage and near the Cabana swimming pool and downtown Rosemary Beach, this posh apartment home also keeps you close to the sparkling white sandy beaches. With a king-size bed and a sleeper sofa in the living area, there’s room for four at Kidd Carriage House.The main level of Kidd Carriage House is located one flight up. Take the cobblestone path and lighted stairway up to the second level, where the front door opens into the bright and elegant GREAT ROOM. The LIVING AREA boasts a serene and calming blue and white palate, with a slip-covered sleeper sofa, two armchairs, a tufted ottoman/coffee table, and a large HDTV. The vaulted ceilings and exposed wood beams add a lovely feeling of spaciousness to this adorable space.Next to the living area is a FULL KITCHEN, with a central island that has seating for four— ideal for dining in or creating an impromptu workspace. Also on the island is a convenient under-counter refrigerator and a separate deep freezer in the garage, so there’s plenty of cold storage space. The full kitchen also includes a dishwasher, a gas range, and a deep, modern farmhouse sink. Over the island are three gorgeous pendant lights that perfectly illuminate the space.In the plush GUEST BEDROOM, a queen-size bed is flanked by two convenient closet spaces. This private oasis is ideal for recharging after a day filled with beachy adventures and also houses a large HDTV for a lazy Netflix binge from bed. In the FULL BATHROOM, you’ll find a spa-like tiled shower with a glass door and a roomy marble-topped vanity. There’s also a full-size stacked washer and dryer.Tucked within the picturesque coastal community of Inlet Beach, you’ll love the central location that keeps you close to everything. When you’re in the mood to catch some sun by the pool, the gorgeous Rosemary Beach community swimming pool is right around the corner. And when it’s time to sink your toes into the sand, the beach access points are a short walk or bike ride from your door.Home HighlightsProfessionally designedSpacious and openFull kitchenWasher and dryer1 Minute Walk to Cabana PoolMain Floor (Sleeps 4)GREAT ROOM and LIVING AREA w/sleeper sofa (Sleeps 2)Efficient, open KITCHENFULL BATHROOMGUEST BEDROOM w/ queen-size bed (Sleeps 2)Also available for rental is the adjacent 4br/4.5 be Kidd Cottage (main house) with a discount for the carriage house if both are rented simultaneously.
